payload.title: [HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-005] Copy masked enqueue diagnostics JSON for support tickets
payload.body:
## Summary

Add a **Copy** control on the execution detail diagnostics panel that copies a JSON blob of **masked** `errors` (and optional `metadata` subset used for correlation) to the clipboard for pasting into issues or chat.

## Scope

- In scope: Client-side clipboard copy; payload must match **masked** data the admin already sees (same rules as API/UI masking).
- Out of scope: Exporting full unredacted server-only payloads.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When diagnostics are shown and `errors` is non-empty, a **Copy diagnostics** (or equivalent) button copies JSON to clipboard.
- [ ] Copied JSON includes only **masked** fields; no additional secret leakage vs on-screen rendering.
- [ ] Success/failure feedback follows existing Hermes patterns (toast or inline text).
- [ ] Unit or component test mocks `navigator.clipboard.writeText` and asserts serialized payload shape.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-002` (panel host); coordinate with `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-003` masking rules
- Blocks: none

## Notes

- **Could-have (P2)** per PRD; schedule after P0/P1 unless support asks to prioritize.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/hermes-enqueue-failure-diagnostics.prd.md
